stem.en: Egyptians called their land Kemet, "the black". What does the name point to?

text.en: The black stone of the Rosetta Stone

feedback.en: The name is about the land. It has nothing to do with one stone found in 1799.

text.en: The dark rock used for the pyramids

feedback.en: The pyramids in this chapter are built of pale limestone. The name is about soil.

text.en: The rich black soil left by the Nile
The dark colour of the desert at night

feedback.en: The name is for what is not desert: the river valley.

explanation.en: Every year the Nile flood left rich black mud on the fields. The land was named after the soil that fed it.

hints.en: What did the flood leave behind on the fields?
